name: Freezume — Career Copilot
description: See how your resume matches any job posting. Analysis runs on your device — your resume never leaves your browser.
_comment_permissions: Permissions arrive with the milestone whose code needs them, never ahead of it.
activeTab grants access to ONE tab, only after the user acts on it, and
only until that tab navigates. It is why there is no host permission for
any job site: there is no standing access to grant or revoke.
M4 (this build): 'contextMenus' for the mandatory manual-selection fallback.
M5 (this build): host access to www.freezume.com ONLY, to read the user's
own resume from their own device. This is the single origin the
extension holds standing access to, and it is the one the user already
trusts with that data. 'tabs' is NOT requested — chrome.tabs.query is
scoped by the host permission we hold, so it returns freezume.com tabs
and the active tab only, never a browsing history.
